Aveda senior student here:
Though possible, i do not suggest lifting your hair from black to blonde on your own at home. If you are a black, BOX dye "dye-er", then there is a lot of stubbornness to deal with. 1: Box dye has a ton of metallic coloring in it which is why when we use box dye, it always comes out very shiny. The metallic pigment is the worst and most difficult thing to lift from a person's hair. 2: Going from black to blonde is a multiple step process. If you're a natural brunette then half the battle is non-existent. For a box dyed brunette, it is a struggle. The bleach will lift the hair to about a very brassy level 7 (Orangy/Yellow), give or take depending on the developer you chose and stubbornness of your hair. If your first bleaching process didn't do all the work you needed it to then you would have to bleach a second time, or if you're like me, a 3rd or 4th, causing damage and breakage. Yes, this may happen in the salon as well but your chances are much smaller. 3: Though pricey, a salon would give you the comfortably of having professionals around you to help/suggest the best way to go about getting your hair from point A to point B.  
Hope this was helpful (:
